4 /-! One global choice of frames aligns both whole radial triangle maps
5 across every cut-tree edge. No pairwise re-selection of coordinates occurs. -/

7 namespace SixVertexUnfolding.ConvexPolyhedron
8 
9 open Set
10 
11 /-- Frames for a fixed collection of local cut-edge triangle placements. -/
12 structure CutTreeFrames {P : ConvexPolyhedron} {a : frontier P.body}
13     (T : P.CutLocusTree a)
14     (charts : ∀ {u v : T.vertices} (edge : T.graph.Adj u v), PlacedCutEdgeTriangles T edge) where
15   transition : ∀ {u v : T.vertices}, T.graph.Adj u v → Plane ≃ᵃⁱ[ℝ] Plane
16   frame : T.vertices → Plane ≃ᵃⁱ[ℝ] Plane
17   reverses : ∀ {u v : T.vertices} (edge : T.graph.Adj u v),
18     (charts edge).Reverses (charts edge.symm) (transition edge)
19   compatible : ∀ {u v : T.vertices} (edge : T.graph.Adj u v) (x : Plane),
20     frame v (transition edge x) = frame u x
21 
22 namespace CutTreeFrames
23 
24 variable {P : ConvexPolyhedron} {a : frontier P.body} {T : P.CutLocusTree a}
25     {charts : ∀ {u v : T.vertices} (edge : T.graph.Adj u v), PlacedCutEdgeTriangles T edge}
26 
27 /-- The same globally placed triangle pair is obtained from either edge orientation. -/
28 theorem global_reversal (frames : CutTreeFrames T charts)
29     {u v : T.vertices} (edge : T.graph.Adj u v) :
30     ((charts edge).inFrame (frames.frame u)).Reverses
31       ((charts edge.symm).inFrame (frames.frame v)) (AffineIsometryEquiv.refl ℝ Plane) :=
32   (frames.reverses edge).in_common_frame (frames.frame u) (frames.frame v) (frames.compatible edge)
33 
34 end CutTreeFrames
35 
36 /-- Arbitrarily chosen genuine local triangle charts have coherent reverse-edge frames. -/
37 theorem exists_cut_tree_frames {P : ConvexPolyhedron} {a : frontier P.body}
38     (T : P.CutLocusTree a)
39     (charts : ∀ {u v : T.vertices} (edge : T.graph.Adj u v), PlacedCutEdgeTriangles T edge) :
40     Nonempty (CutTreeFrames T charts) := by
41   classical
42   letI : Fintype T.vertices := T.finite_vertices.fintype
43   let root : T.vertices := Classical.choice T.tree.connected.nonempty
44   obtain ⟨motion, frame, valid, _, compatible⟩ := TreeFrames.exists_frames_for_transitions
45     T.graph T.tree root (fun {_ _} edge transition => (charts edge).Reverses (charts edge.symm) transition)
46     (fun {_ _} edge => (charts edge).exists_reversal (charts edge.symm))
47     (fun {_ _} _ _ valid => valid.symm)
48   exact ⟨⟨@motion, frame, valid, compatible⟩⟩
49 
50 end SixVertexUnfolding.ConvexPolyhedron
